name: @samiyev/agentsoul
description: Soul-kit for Claude Code: soul (always loaded) → skills (guides and setup dialogs, on demand) → subagents (isolated executors with narrow tools and explicit models). Installs, updates safely, validates.

scripts.check: npm run build && node dist/cli.js check --source && node dist/cli.js check
scripts.dogfood: npm run build && node dist/cli.js update
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs && node dist/cli.js check --source
